blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `deleteSearchIndexStep`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This step deletes a search index: every physical index ever built for it is
dropped from its engine, along with the versions and sync history behind them.
There is no compensation — a dropped index can only be rebuilt.

children.name: index
children.description: The name of the index to delete.

types.name: SearchIndexDeleteResult
types.description: The result returned after an index is deleted.

children.name: index
children.description: The name of the index that was deleted.

children.name: deleted_versions
children.description:
How many of the index's versions were dropped. `0` when the index is
registered but was never migrated, so nothing was ever built for it.
